data.description: 【飞鸟马时 · 千年走廊提裙礼】千年学园阳光斑驳的长廊上，身穿经典黑白女仆装的时微微提起蕾丝裙摆，向迎面走来的你行了一个无可挑剔的皇家礼。虽然面无表情，但蔚蓝的眼眸却透着一丝认真的呆萌——「早上好，主人。今天的女仆兼护卫任务已启动……请问需要时为您提供什么服务呢？Peace ✌️。」
data.promptProse: Toki performs a precise curtsey in the sunlit Millennium corridor, gently lifting the edge of her maid combat skirt while keeping a composed, earnest expression. Her blonde braid, headset and small armor accents remain visible in the eye-level medium view. Window frames repeat down the hall behind her. Morning light catches the lace edge and white fabric panels, with orderly frame shadows across the corridor floor.
data.title: 飞鸟马时 · 千年走廊提裙礼
